sources.title: domenicor046/ink9um-dense · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Read this before comparing against "the released model" The 14 released checkpoints vary by up to 0.14 in held-out balanced accuracy depending on which one you pick, and seed42/step-075000, the most natural default, ranks last of 14 on w016. seed43 checkpoints are systematically better on two of three regions.

sources.title: DomRusso2/ink9um-dense - GitHub
sources.snippet: On pherc0814-46527 the dense model recovers the ring shape that the control smears into a single blob, which is the region where the improvement is both largest and clearly outside seed noise. On pherc1667-w029 the labelled area is two small letters in a mostly negative region, and all three models look broadly similar.

sources.title: domenicor046/ink9um-dense-labels · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Dense pseudo-labels for the 9 um ink corpus 288.7 M supervised pixels across 7 aligned segments, against 5.8 M in the manual labels those segments ship with. Same layout and same zarr parameters as scrollprizeink_9um/labels, so it drops into a training config by changing one path.
